name: feat.daggerheart-domain-card-terrify-feature
description: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, the target marks 1d4 Stress and you can choose to make the target run one range away from you (Close to Far, Far to Very Far, etc). On a success with Fear, the target becomes temporarily Vulnerable.
